svg.title: Caret
svg.desc: The proofreader's caret, the mark for "insert here", with a dot: an A, and an edit. It ties the name to review and to writing, reads at 16 pixels as a clear A, and needs no letterforms drawn. Weak where a plain chevron already means "collapse" or "up"; the dot is what tells them apart, and it's small at 16.
